title: AjustaCV Pro: pricing-logic explainer
summary: A 15 s silent-feeling pricing argument for a CV tool: a serif question, job cards stacking 1 to 10, a per-job vs Pro price comparison where the per-job total counts up and gets struck through, a feature grid, a dark 'cost of waiting' beat and a checkout card, ending on a blue logo card. Calm, editorial, almost like a well-designed pricing page that animates itself.
fit_reason: Exactly the 'show the math' argument an agency owner buys on; light, calm, rebuilt UI cards and one blue accent map straight onto SaaSSuite pricing and ROI posts.

palette.mood: light airy editorial, one cobalt accent, single dark contrast beat

typography.display: high-contrast transitional serif (Tiempos/Source Serif-like) for headlines and big prices; small geometric sans (DM Sans/Inter) for UI labels
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: 3-line serif headline left-aligned at ~6% frame height, prices ~5%, UI microcopy tiny
typography.notes: Last line of the question is set in cobalt #265eed to carry the hook; small-caps-style tracked labels ('AVULSO, VAGA POR VAGA', 'PRO, TODAS AS VAGAS') above each card.

text_animation: line-by-line mask reveal rising from a baseline clip (0.1 s shows only the top half of line 1)
numbers count up per row as the list grows (R$ 7,80 -> 39,00 -> 78,00)
big price fades up from 20% opacity grey to full black inside its card
struck-through total when the comparison is won
card title 'O que entra no Pro' types/reveals inside a blue card
motion: job-card deck fans in from the right edge, each card tilted then settling into a stacked pile (1 vaga -> 10 vagas counter)
list rows append one by one, pushing total down
feature tiles pop in on a grid with small blue dot badges
soft ease-out on everything, no overshoot
transitions: hard cut to dark slate (#1a1814) for the emotional beat
empty card outline draws first, contents fade in (11.3 -> 12.6)
cut to full-bleed cobalt logo card
graphic_elements: UI cards with 1px blue-grey border and very light blue fill
green callout strip ('A partir de 2 vagas...')
small blue dot markers on feature tiles
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI: flat pricing cards, list rows and a checkout card recreated in vector, no device frame, generous whitespace

sound.sfx: soft UI ticks likely on count-ups
sound.sync: beats change roughly every 2-3 s, not tightly beat-locked

signature_moves: serif question with the last line in the accent colour
per-unit cost list counting up next to a fixed Pro price, then the total gets struck through
one dark 'cost of inaction' slide in the middle of an otherwise white video
checkout card as the closing product shot

best_segments.what: Serif question masks in line by line while job cards fan in and a '1 vaga -> 10 vagas' counter climbs
Per-job list grows and counts up beside the fixed Pro price card, green callout appears, total gets struck through
Dark cost-of-waiting statement then cut to white checkout card drawing in with blue CTA

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion. Build cards in HTML, mask-reveal headline lines (overflow hidden + translateY 100%->0), count numbers with a tween, strike-through as an animated line width, single hard cut to dark slide.
recreate.prompt: Light #fcfefd canvas, left-aligned serif headline with the last line in cobalt #265eed; flat pricing cards with 1px border; per-unit list counts up row by row next to a fixed plan price, total gets struck through; one dark #1a1814 'cost of waiting' slide; end on a cobalt logo card. Calm ease-out, no voice.
